column3: “Pile up the bones” is rendered “pile wood,” following a slightly different reading.
“Rust” follows a rare word; NASB supplies “Take out of it.”
“Complete the meat” is rendered “Boil the flesh well,” and “mix the seasoning” follows a difficult word.
“Toil” is a rare word; NASB has “She has wearied Me with toil.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Because I cleansed you” is rendered “Because I would have cleansed you.”
“Groaning be silent” is rendered “Groan silently,” and “sandals” as “shoes.”
